headline.reading: the kit does NOT over-trust gamma's level: every drug hypothesis is level-invariant (TEST A) and the level enters zero claims (TEST B). The one residual level-proxy -- promoter-gamma standing in for a position-displaced E-CIS fold -- is named, restricted to a topology-direction claim, and the over-reach is retired.

inherited_anchors.note: validation is strictly READ-ONLY over the frozen 128-core; mapped_levers + disease_inputs must reproduce the V8 record byte-for-byte before any test runs.

inherited_source_warrant.fact: DNA carries ONE stiffness signal: gamma is its LEVEL (window-mean scalar); A4 is its SHAPE (the same signal with that mean removed). They are orthogonal projections, neither nested. A4 carries NONE of the level gamma is (robust_z subtracts the per-locus median = gamma).
inherited_source_warrant.kit_relevance: the kit's cusp control scalar IS this gamma: vp_emergence_correction.py computes gamma = -mean(NN dG37) over the promoter window -- the LEVEL, the window mean; the within-window position/shape is averaged out.
inherited_source_warrant.retired_at_source: gamma is a coarse A4 / gamma is one of the A4 coordinates / gamma SUBSET A4
inherited_source_warrant.source_programme: dna_vp_site -- A Deterministic Two-Layer Interpretation of DNA (v1.13)

retired_framing.falsified_by: the inherited [V] orthogonality (A4 carries none of the level gamma is; max|corr|=0.327) -- a window MEAN cannot carry within-window position; AND TEST A (the kit's direction is gamma-independent, so the displaced-lesion claim was never warranted by gamma's value to begin with).
retired_framing.mirror_of_source_tombstone: dna_vp_site §8 retired register: 'gamma is a coarse A4 / gamma SUBSET A4'
retired_framing.must_not_revive_as: e.g. 'the promoter gamma is the deep-intronic well', 'fragility ranks the splice severity', 'the barrier sets the splice threshold'.
retired_framing.retired_irreversible: the promoter window-mean gamma CHARACTERISES a position-displaced lesion's OWN cusp / gamma carries the lesion's positional shape / the promoter barrier value governs a deep-intronic or enhancer-displaced fold
retired_framing.standing_statement: gamma is the LEVEL (promoter window-mean). It warrants ONLY (i) that a bistable barrier EXISTS (gamma>0 -> a real switch), from which the gamma-INDEPENDENT direction follows, and (ii) [V] geometry + [O] feasibility reads. It does NOT carry a position-displaced lesion's shape. For displaced lesions the claim is TOPOLOGY-DIRECTION only.

test_A_level_invariance.interpretation: the kit's ACTUAL hypotheses (direction + mechanism sign = the drug join keys, + gamma-restore inclusion) are invariant to gamma's LEVEL: the kit reads the topological polarity (the 'shape' analogue), not the level. The ONLY things that move with the level are the fragility RANK and the [O] feasibility hint -- non-hypothesis quantities. Over-trust of gamma's level INTO A CLAIM = 0.
test_A_level_invariance.method: for each frozen disease, derive_lever_families re-run across a gamma band spanning below REG_LO=1.25 to above the observed max 1.6194, plus an additive +0.25 level shift (the site self-check 'raise the whole line'); hypothesis tuple checked byte-identical.

fields.what_it_is: from corrective_h_polarity ONLY -- the drug join key

test_B_level_leak_inventory.interpretation: gamma's LEVEL enters ONLY [V] geometry reads + a ranking hint + an [O]-graded feasibility hint. It enters ZERO direction/sign claims. The hypothesis is carried by the lesion polarity triplet (lesion, healthy_branch, corrective_h_polarity), which is gamma-free.

abstentions_track_the_level_shape_bounda.why_level_shape: AT-rich GAA gives Dg<0: no stacking-dominant fold; silencing is triplex/R-loop at a POSITION -- a shape lesion, not a level one.
its drive is one NUCLEAR promoter's occupancy (Track A), not a population-of-genomes threshold on the shared control-region well.

abstentions_track_the_level_shape_bounda.abstains_on: multi-locus imprinting disturbance (MLID) / large contiguous 15q11-13 deletion / whole-arm UPD
abstentions_track_the_level_shape_bounda.why_level_shape: MANY loci -- no single promoter window-mean gamma; a multi-locus / large-CNV structure.
whole-chromosome dosage -- not a single-gene promoter well.
a TRANS effect across many genes -- not a single cis node on one promoter's gamma.

classification.lesion_node: coding LOF/GOF/missense on the GENE'S OWN promoter cusp
classification.reason: the cusp the lesion perturbs IS the gene's promoter; gamma is the proper coordinate, and the direction is gamma-independent anyway (TEST A).
classification.relevant_well: the gene's own promoter (gamma = its window-mean)

classification.lesion_node: expansion that silences the gene's OWN promoter (CpG/heterochromatin)
classification.reason: compares two means (repeat-fold level vs promoter level) -- a legitimate level operation; ABSTAINS on GAA (Dg<0, AT-rich, triplex/R-loop) -- the positional case.
classification.relevant_well: the gene's own promoter; applicability is a LEVEL-vs-LEVEL test Dg = g_rpt(unit) - gamma_promoter > 0

classification.reason: copy number = dose = level; the promoter is the gene's own.
classification.relevant_well: the gene's own promoter; dose scales the drive

classification.reason: monoallelic dose is a level fact; the promoter is the gene's own.
classification.relevant_well: the gene's own promoter; allelic dose = level

classification.lesion_node: population-of-genomes functional occupancy past a heteroplasmy threshold
classification.reason: gamma is the read of the well whose spinodal IS the threshold; per-disease specificity comes from occupancy, not gamma -- consistent with TEST A.
classification.relevant_well: the mtDNA control-region (LSP+HSP1) gamma -- SHARED by all mtDNA diseases; the threshold IS its spinodal

classification.lesion_node: splice/enhancer-occupancy lesion at a DISPLACED intronic/exonic POSITION (CEP290 intron-26 cryptic exon; ELP1 intron-20 splice; SMN2 exon-7 element)
classification.reason: the lesion is a POSITION fact kb from the promoter; the promoter window-mean gamma is a LEVEL PROXY for a fold that lives elsewhere. The DIRECTION still holds (gamma-independent, TEST A), but the promoter barrier/fragility/feasibility do NOT characterise the displaced lesion's own local shape.
classification.relevant_well: promoter gamma is USED as the well width, but the fold physically sits at the splice site / cryptic exon -- DISPLACED from the promoter
classification.restriction: claim restricted to TOPOLOGY-DIRECTION only: 'a bistable well exists on this gene (gamma>0) so a splice-restoring lever exists, direction=increase'. The promoter barrier VALUE is NOT asserted to govern the displaced lesion.

test_C_displaced_lesion_and_abstentions.consistency_finding: every kit abstention is precisely a shape / multi-locus case a single window-mean gamma cannot model -- the kit's self-imposed limits already track the level/shape boundary (convergent evidence).
test_C_displaced_lesion_and_abstentions.interpretation: of the six modelled subclasses, FIVE are LEVEL-clean (the well the lesion perturbs IS the read gamma's well) and ONE (E-CIS, 3 diseases) uses promoter-gamma as a LEVEL PROXY for a position-displaced fold; that one is flagged and restricted to a topology-direction claim.
